comments.content:
EPIC COMPLETE — Tier-1 self-verification maxed. Six soundness-critical pure functions are now genuinely Verus-verified (verus --no-cheating: 26 verified, 0 errors), each anchored to its PRODUCTION consumer + critic-clean:
1. effects::subsumes — effect subsumption (65536-pair exhaustive equivalence) [fb4512f]
2. degrade::ladder_action — the degrade ANTI-CHEAT, counterexample-never-degrades (run_ladder branches on it; observable closures-not-run) [0125d12]
3. sandbox::io_allow/syscall_allowlist — seccomp soundness: pure->no I/O + monotonicity + deny-by-default (256-mask equivalence) [0125d12]
4. lower::should_emit_external_body — the boundary HONESTY gate: a regular fn never laundered to L3 (observable-dispatch) [4dcfabf]
5. manifest::aggregate_level — project = min, no over-claim (341-list enumeration) [4dcfabf]
6. mutation::meets_floor_60 — the #48 anti-Goodhart: 0/0 never passes (f64<->integer grid, 0 divergences, critic-reverified to 0..=5000 + 200k boundary ratios) [4dcfabf]

Mechanism: a thermite-verified crate (verus!{} spec + contract + proof fns, --no-cheating, no assume/admit/external_body on any core) + (c) exhaustive/observable equivalence binding the production fn (delegation infeasible — vstd won't cargo-compile). The TCB shrinks: the soundness-critical anti-cheat/honesty decisions are now machine-PROVED, not just tested.

Tier-1 COVERAGE BOUNDARY (honestly OUT — not a deferral dodge): cache_key (SHA-256, cryptographic), vacuity::triage + mutation::generate (AST-walks over UNBOUNDED programs — not exhaustively checkable, Tier-2-adjacent), is_strictly_stronger (structural). Rule: Tier-1 iff soundness reduces to a finite enumerable domain. Tier 2 (functional lowerer correctness) = research-scale (CompCert-class), out. Tier 3 (I/O / Command / fs) = #[verifier::external_body] = Verus's #[boundary], assumed (the trusted floor: Verus+Z3+rustc + the I/O shims). workspace 432 tests, clippy/fmt clean.
